'''Romi Moola''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]<ref name="SW:BH" /> [[Homeworld/Legends|from]] the [[Desert/Legends|desert]]<ref name="Prima" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="SW:BH" /> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[Slavery/Legends|Owned]] by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]],<ref name="Prima" /> the leader of a [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal empire]],<ref name="Jabba">{{CSWECite|II|130|Jabba the Hutt (Jabba Desilijic Tiure)}}</ref> he<ref name="Prima" /> resided within [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] on Tatooine.<ref name="SW:BH" /> By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'' to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> Moola attempted to [[Death/Legends|kill]] his [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Slaver/Legends|enslaver]] by [[Poison/Legends|poisoning]] Jabba's [[Chuba stew/Legends|chuba stew]].<ref name="SW:BH" /> The [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] failed when Jabba's [[Unidentified chef (Jabba Desilijic Tiure)|loyal chef]] died after taste-testing the [[Stew/Legends|stew]]. The [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] learned of Moola's treachery, but by then she had fled the palace<ref name="TCSWE" /> and sought refuge in the [[Imperial Station Bravo|palace]] of [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the Hutt]], leader of her own [[Gardulla the Elder's criminal empire|criminal empire]]. Jabba placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Moola, offering 3,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] if brought back alive and 1,500 credits if dead. The bounty was taken up by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="SW:BH" /> While Moola was talking with the [[Human]] [[Redge Dunlak]] and the [[Jawa]] [[Kiatha]],<ref name="Prima" /> she was captured by Fett.<ref name="TCSWE" /> Moola had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], mottled orange and yellow skin, and wore a silver headpiece.<ref name="SW:BH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Romi Moola first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'', a [[2002]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SW:BH" /> Moola's bounty is optional, and not required for players to complete the game.<ref name="SW:BH" /> Despite being optional, ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'',<ref name="TCSWE" /> released in [[2008]],<ref name="Penguin">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/160596/the-complete-star-wars-encyclopedia-by-stephen-j-sansweet-pablo-hidalgo-bob-vitas-daniel-wallace/9780345477637|text=The Complete Star Wars® Encyclopedia}}</ref> established that Jango Fett did capture Moola.<ref name="TCSWE" /> During gameplay, the scanner Fett uses to identify bounties incorrectly depicts Moola as having white skin and wearing black [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]].<ref name="SW:BH" />
